name: Runway
summary: Video, image and audio generation (Gen-4.5 and hosted third-party models) as asynchronous tasks.

api_secret.description: A Runway API secret from the Developer Portal (dev.runway.com). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Generation is asynchronous: a generation POST returns only {"id": ...}; poll runway.tasks.get with backoff until status is SUCCEEDED, FAILED or CANCELLED. THROTTLED means queued behind your rate limit, not an error.

Request bodies are a union keyed on model: the allowed ratio, duration, prompt length and optional fields change per model. Never carry a ratio or duration from one model to another; look the model up in the API reference.
Credits cost $0.01 each and are charged per generation (per second of video for most video models); see the pricing page.
Output URLs on a finished task are temporary: download anything you keep.
Avatars, voices, recipes, model routers and workflows exist but are not listed here.

endpoints.name: Generate a video from text
endpoints.summary: Starts a text-to-video task; returns a task id to poll.

model.description: Model id, e.g. gen4.5, veo3.1, veo3.1_fast, kling3.0_pro, seedance2. The other fields' allowed values depend on it.

promptText.description: What should appear in the video; up to 1000 characters for gen4.5 (limit varies by model). Required by most models.
promptText.example: A timelapse on a sunny day with clouds flying by

ratio.description: Output resolution as width:height; gen4.5 takes 1280:720 or 720:1280 and requires it.

duration.description: Seconds of video; gen4.5 takes an integer 2 to 10 and requires it. Range varies by model.

notes: A read over POST that spends credits (gen4.5: 12 credits per second of video). Poll runway.tasks.get with the returned id.

endpoints.name: Generate a video from an image
endpoints.summary: Starts an image-to-video task from a start frame and optional prompt; returns a task id to poll.

model.description: Model id, e.g. gen4.5, gen4_turbo, veo3.1, kling3.0_pro. The other fields' allowed values depend on it.

promptImage.description: HTTPS URL, Runway upload URI or base64 data URI (up to 5MB) of the input image. Some models also take an array of {uri, position} frames.

promptText.description: What should happen in the video; required for gen4.5 (up to 1000 characters).

ratio.description: Output resolution as width:height; gen4.5 takes 1280:720, 720:1280, 1104:832, 960:960, 832:1104 or 1584:672.

duration.description: Seconds of video; gen4.5 takes 2 to 10. Range varies by model.

notes: A read over POST that spends credits (gen4.5: 12, gen4_turbo: 5 credits per second). Poll runway.tasks.get with the returned id.

endpoints.name: Generate an image from text and reference images
endpoints.summary: Starts a text/image-to-image task; returns a task id to poll.

model.description: Model id, e.g. gen4_image, gen4_image_turbo, gpt_image_2, gemini_image3_pro, ideogram_4_0. The other fields' allowed values depend on it.

promptText.description: What the image should show; up to 1000 characters for gen4_image.

ratio.description: Output resolution as width:height, e.g. 1920:1080, 1080:1920, 1024:1024; required by most models.

referenceImages.description: Up to three reference images (gen4_image_turbo needs one to three).

notes: A read over POST that spends credits (gen4_image: 5 per 720p or 8 per 1080p image; gen4_image_turbo: 2). Poll runway.tasks.get with the returned id.

endpoints.name: Get a task's status and output
endpoints.summary: Status (PENDING, THROTTLED, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CANCELLED) and, on success, output URLs.

id.description: Task id (UUID) returned by a generation call.

notes: Only SUCCEEDED carries output; FAILED carries failure and failureCode. Poll with backoff.

endpoints.name: Cancel or delete a task
endpoints.summary: Cancels a running task or deletes a finished one.

endpoints.name: Get organization credits and tier
endpoints.summary: Credit balance, usage tier and limits for the project that owns the key.

endpoints.name: Query credit usage
endpoints.summary: Credits used per day and model over a date range.

startDate.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to 30 days before the current date.

beforeDate.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD, not inclusive; defaults to 30 days after startDate.
